# Bugs in the works—biology at ICI Billingham

Journal of Biological Education. Published: 1992-12-01. 6 citations.

## Abstract

The chemical factory at Billingham was in existence before ICI was farmed, but biological research leading to manufacturing processes did not start until the late 1960s with a project to make single cell protein. Although the Pruteen product was manufactured successfully on a 50 000 tonne/year scale, its commercial life was short and the production plant no longer exists. However, the biotechnology skills that were developed have been applied to a variety of new products and there is now a growing business based on the exploitation of microorganisms, to make products suited to an increasingly environmentally-conscious age.
